summary.text: Greg Wilson is a Republican state representative from Kansas House District 70 who has represented the district since August 2025 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Wilson was appointed to the seat by precinct committee members after Rep. Scott Hill left it.

paragraphs.text: Greg Wilson took office in the Kansas House of Representatives on August 1, 2025, succeeding Scott Hill in District 70.
According to Ballotpedia, precinct committee members from parts of Dickinson, Marion and McPherson counties appointed Wilson to replace Hill.
He faces Democrat Kylie Kilmer in the general election.
